record.question: Which among the following is not a neighboring state of Gujarat?
record.explanation: Answer C: Uttar Pradesh. Uttar Pradesh does not border Gujarat; Rajasthan, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh do. Reference: https://gujaratindia.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
